movements.name: Blackgaze
movements.about: Black metal played with the walls of guitar and the haze of shoegaze, from the late 2000s on.

movements.name: Post-punk and after
movements.about: What came out of punk at the end of the 1970s: post-punk, gothic rock and new wave, and the synth and dark wave sounds that grew from them.

movements.name: Industrial
movements.about: Noise, machines and rhythm, from the industrial records of the late 1970s to the body music and the metal and rock bands that took them up.

movements.name: Emo and post-hardcore
movements.about: Hardcore punk turned inward, from the mid-1980s on: emo, post-hardcore and screamo, and the math rock and pop punk around them.

movements.name: Doom and drone
movements.about: Slow, heavy and long: doom and sludge metal, stoner rock, and the drone and dark ambient records that stretch the sound out further.

rules.ladders: every path from the tag up to its broad tag, through its parents (the nearest heads in use under the same broad tag)
rules.children: the tags whose nearest head is this one
rules.spellings: each way Plex spells the tag (album, artist and track genres) and the tag rules that turned it into this tag (jimbo-dj's tag_rules.json)
rules.tracks: live tracks carrying the tag by jimbo-dj's per-track rule (history._genre_tags: the album's Plex genres, then the track's own, through the tag rules, junk left out)
rules.plays: HISTORY's counted plays (counted = 1) of those tracks, all time: jimbo-dj's Top genres rule (a play counts for every tag its library track carries; a play with no library track has no genre)
rules.sound: albums whose analyzer styles name the tag (a style counts for an album when at least 40% of its analysed tracks keep it: jimbo-dj's sound count)
rules.profile: what the tag's plays sounded like: the analysis of its tracks, each weighted by its plays (jimbo-dj's history.sound_of; at least 20 analysed plays)
rules.line: one line per broad tag: its tags as stations, each on its rung (a tag under two parents is a station on both branches)
rules.movement: a named set of tags across broad tags, from traqfreq's movements.json; it changes no ladder and no count

checks.rule: Every broad tag with albums under it has the same albums, albums carrying it, albums missing it and children (with their albums) as jimbo-dj's families: its rules run here and its stored library.tags (a stored row that differs passes only when it is stale); every ladder ends at jimbo-dj's broad tag.
Every live track's tags equal jimbo-dj's per-track rule (history._genre_tags), and the analyzer styles it keeps equal jimbo-dj's strict test (genres.Styles.sound_genres).

Every tag's numbers (albums, artists, tracks, MusicBrainz, sound, issues), the album issue counts, the fixes and the suggestions equal jimbo-dj's stored library.tags (a stored row that differs passes only when it is stale).

rules.ladder: Every broad tag with albums under it has the same albums, albums carrying it, albums missing it and children (with their albums) as jimbo-dj's families: its rules run here and its stored library.tags (a stored row that differs passes only when it is stale); every ladder ends at jimbo-dj's broad tag.
rules.tracks: Every live track's tags equal jimbo-dj's per-track rule (history._genre_tags), and the analyzer styles it keeps equal jimbo-dj's strict test (genres.Styles.sound_genres).
rules.audit: Every tag's numbers (albums, artists, tracks, MusicBrainz, sound, issues), the album issue counts, the fixes and the suggestions equal jimbo-dj's stored library.tags (a stored row that differs passes only when it is stale).
rules.passed: Passed when all three checks pass.

/api/tags/compare.read_only: Read-only: the gate reads traqfreq's own answers, built from jimbo-dj's database opened read-only. Nothing is written to jimbo-dj, Plex or the files.
